overview.description: The MicroSectors Gold - 3X Inverse Leveraged ETNs (DULL) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the LBMA Gold Price index. The fund is an exchange-traded note that provides 300% daily inverse leveraged exposure to the spot price of gold by tracking GLD, an ETF that physically holds gold bars. DULL was launched on Feb 24, 2023 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
